import { test, expect } from "vitest"
import { notifyUser } from "../src/notify"

test("notifies the user once per event", async () => {
  const calls: string[] = []
  await notifyUser({ id: "e1" }, { send: async (message) => calls.push(message) })
  expect(calls.length).toBe(EXPECTED_CALLS)
})
